scope: Historical observational audit. All original test await and assertion text retained; no production timing or test oracle changed. resources: GNU time runs inside serialized benchmark lock and explicit offline harness; queue and namespace setup excluded. Uncontrolled shared-host load remains.

guards: Unshare --user --map-current-user --net --keep-caps; bring up loopback, verify only loopback/no routes, then setpriv drops inherited/ambient/bounding capabilities before GNU time and bun run test.
